item.title: SMS Verification Platforms: My Honest, Ad-Free Rundown
item.description: Signing up for services like GPT, Claude, or Telegram needs a number that can receive verification codes — but you may not want to hand over your own phone number. That demand spawned a batch of SMS verification platforms: some free, some paid, some aimed at developers. Here are four I’ve actually used; as of May 20, 2026, all were still accessible. Platform status changes at any time, so open the site and check yourself before using one.
